name: Fukushima Souta
source: A relative to the girls. 6 years younger than Yuri. Since his parents are travelling abroad, the sisters are taking care of him. Bright, honest and curious. He likes to be mischievous. Initially, he did everything Yuri told him, but slowly he stops listening...
